claim: Smoothing observations with an RBF kernel and computing ECE of the smoothed function yields a consistent calibration measure (SmoothECE) with a hyperparameter-free reliability diagram.
stance_target: L1: calibration metrics choice beyond binned ECE
scope_conditions: Binary-outcome probabilistic predictors; Abstract and Definition 1
quoted_support: We prove that with a careful choice of bandwidth, this method yields a calibration measure that is well-behaved in the sense of Błasiok, Gopalan, Hu, and Nakkiran (2023) — a consistent calibration measure.
